note: Whitewater Lake, a Southern Unit family campground on Hi-Lo Road: wooded West (750s-770s) and East (600s) loops either side of the road, with four walk-to sites (771-774). The lake's beach and boat launch are a short drive south on State Park Road. Hickory Woods Group Camp shares the entrance; the forest's horseriders' campground is a separate area. --Claude
